DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご説明した流れについて、質問はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the process I explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の住所変更を申し込む前に、家族と新しい住所の書き方を確かめたいです。帰って説明できるよう、順番をメモしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座住所変更前に家族と住所表記を確認するため手続順を記録したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before applying to change the address on my account, I want to check with my family how to write the new address. May I note down the steps so I can explain them at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to record the procedure so you can confirm the address format with your family before changing your account address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞ。分かりにくかった箇所をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do. Tell me which parts were unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初に相談して、そのあと必要な書類を確認するところです。書類を持ってくれば必ず終わる、という意味で書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類持参で必ず完了すると誤記した点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The part about consulting you first and then checking the required documents. I wrote it as though bringing the documents would guarantee completion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that you mistakenly wrote that bringing the documents guarantees completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の説明では、状況を伺ってから必要な手続を確認するとお伝えしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today I explained that we would ask about your circumstances before checking which procedures are necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まず相談して内容を確認する、と書き直します。来店した日のうちに終わるかは、まだ聞いていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に状況相談と内容確認と書き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll change it to “consult first and confirm the details.” We haven't yet discussed whether it can be completed on the day I visit, have we?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Revise your note to say you will first discuss your circumstances and confirm the details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、家族へ伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything else you want to tell your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の住所を確認した後に、私が持ってくる物を聞きたいです。住所変更の相談内容をお話ししてから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所表記の確認後に住所変更相談の持参物を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: After confirming the new address, I want to ask what I should bring. I'll check after explaining what I want to discuss about the address change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to confirm what to bring for the address-change consultation after checking how to write the new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も含め、次回の相談で伺います。今日はこのメモでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll discuss that at your next consultation too. Will these notes be sufficient for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日の説明と、次回聞きたいことを別の欄に書けました。家で相談してから、改めて来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明済事項と次回質問を別欄にまとめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've put today's explanation and my questions for next time in separate columns. I'll discuss it at home and come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have organized the information already explained and your questions for next time in separate columns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知いたしました。それでは、ご家族とご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please discuss it with your family. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約品のお受け取りですね。お名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to collect your reserved items, correct? May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中です。二つ予約しましたが、今日は自転車なので、両方を一度に持って帰れそうにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車で予約二品を同時に持帰れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tanaka. I reserved two items, but I'm on my bicycle today, so I don't think I can take both home at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot take both reserved items home at once by bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内容を確認します。どちらを今日お持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your reservation. Which one would you like to take home today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい箱を先に受け取りたいです。大きい方は、家族に車を出してもらえる日に取りに来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小箱だけ今日受取り大箱は車のある日に希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to collect the small box first. I'd like to collect the large one on a day when my family can bring the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect only the small box today and the large box on a day when a car is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保管できる期間を担当に確認しますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person in charge how long we can hold it. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。勝手に来週まで置いてもらえると思って来たので、難しければ別の方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管期間を確認し難しい場合の方法も考えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I came assuming you could keep it until next week, so if that's difficult, I'll consider another way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the storage period and consider another option if keeping it is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から、あさってまでならお預かりできるとのことです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge says we can hold it until the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あさってなら家族が休みです。その日に大きい箱を受け取り、今日は小さい箱だけを持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提示されたあさっての大箱受取りに同意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family has that day off. I'll collect the large box then and take only the small box home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to collect the large box the day after tomorrow, as offered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取日の変更を記録します。控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record the change of collection date. Do you have your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。この控えを次も持ってきます。今日受け取った小さい箱に印をつけていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えに本日受取分を記入してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll bring it next time too. It would help if you could mark the small box I collected today on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to note today's collected item on your receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えにも記入しました。それでは、小さい箱をお渡しします。またあさってお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've marked your receipt too. Here is the small box. We'll see you the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体操の集合場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the meeting place for the exercises?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は分かりました。友達が見学に遅れて来るので、迷わずここへ来られる説明を送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅れる見学者へ集合場所の説明を送りたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've found it. A friend is arriving late to watch, so I want to send directions that will get them here without getting lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send directions to the meeting place to a visitor who is arriving late to watch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お友達は、どちらの入口から来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which entrance will your friend use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ聞いていません。私が使った入口と同じだと思って、右へ曲がってとだけ送ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口未確認で右折案内を送ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked yet. I assumed it was the entrance I used and just sent “turn right.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you sent directions to turn right without checking the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口が違うと分かりにくいですね。集合場所の表示は、こちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That could be confusing if they use a different entrance. Here is the sign for the meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この表示の名前を送ります。友達には入る入口も聞いて、そこから来るように伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示名を送り利用入口も友人へ聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll send the name on this sign. I'll also ask which entrance my friend will use, then tell them how to get here from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will send the name on the sign and ask your friend which entrance they will use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見学される方は、体操する方の周りに十分な場所をあけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Observers should leave plenty of space around the people doing the exercises.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友達は一緒に動かずに見ていたいそうなので、邪魔にならない所で待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学者は運動の邪魔にならない場所で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My friend says they want to watch without joining in, so I'll ask them to wait somewhere they won't be in the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the observer will wait somewhere that does not interfere with the exercises. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開始前に来られなければ、到着してから係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If they cannot arrive before we start, please have them speak to a staff member when they arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そう伝えます。さっき送った右へ曲がるという案内は消して、表示名と、着いたら係に声をかけることを送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧案内を取り消し到着時に係へ声かけする案内を送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them. I'll delete my earlier directions to turn right and send the name on the sign and instructions to speak to staff on arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Withdraw the old directions and send instructions to speak to staff on arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: これで待ち合わせしやすくなりますね。それでは、ご友人にもよろしくお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should make meeting up easier. Please pass my regards to your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらまでお出かけですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は祖母の見送りです。私は電車に乗りませんが、祖母が座って休める所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電車には乗らず祖母見送りの待合席を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm here to see my grandmother off today. I'm not taking the train, but I'm looking for somewhere she can sit and rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are not taking the train and are looking for waiting seats while seeing your grandmother off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札の外にも、こちらの待合席があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are waiting seats here outside the ticket gates too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこなら私も一緒に座れますね。祖母の切符はあります。時間まで二人でここにいてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札外の席で二人が時間まで休む希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I can sit with her there. She has her ticket. May we both stay here until it's time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you would both like to rest in the seats outside the gates until departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかのお客様と譲り合ってお使いください。何時の列車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please share the seats considerately with other passengers. What time is her train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示に出ている次の列車です。改札までゆっくり歩きたいので、早めに席を立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象列車を示しゆっくり歩けるよう早めに立つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The next train shown on the display. We want to walk slowly to the gate, so we'll leave our seats early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the train and say you will get up early so you can walk slowly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗る方は、この改札から進めます。ホームの案内も見えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Passengers can go through this gate. You can see the platform signs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 祖母にはここから先の案内を一緒に見てもらいます。私は改札の外で別れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 祖母と先の案内を確認し改札外で別れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the directions beyond here with my grandmother. I'll say goodbye outside the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the onward directions with your grandmother and say goodbye outside the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの荷物は、お祖母様がご自身で運べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can your grandmother carry her luggage herself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さいかばん一つです。今は私が持っていますが、立つ前に祖母へ渡します。案内を教えていただいて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小かばんを席から立つ前に祖母へ渡すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's just one small bag. I'm carrying it now, but I'll give it to her before we get up. Thank you for showing us the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will give your grandmother the small bag before getting up from your seats. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お祖母様にもよい旅を。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Have a good trip, both of you, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示板のご案内についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a notice on the bulletin board, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私たちの交流会が昨日終わりました。貼っていただいた案内を外してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 終了した交流会の掲示撤去を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Our exchange gathering ended yesterday. I'd like you to remove the notice you put up for us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to remove the notice for an exchange gathering that has ended. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の題名と、申し込んだ方のお名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the title of the notice and the name of the person who applied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「日曜の日本語交流会」です。申込者は私、鈴木です。控えも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 催し題名と申込者名と控えを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: “Sunday Japanese Exchange Gathering.” I'm Suzuki, the applicant. I've brought my receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the event title and applicant's name, and show the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 該当する掲示を確認できました。今日、担当が外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've found the notice. The person in charge will remove it today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まだ参加できると思って電話する人がいるので、早めに外れると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 募集継続の誤解を避け早めの撤去希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. People are calling because they think they can still attend, so I'd appreciate it being removed soon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want it removed soon to prevent people thinking registration is still open. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外した紙は、引き取りをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to collect the removed sheets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚だけ記録として残したいです。全部を持ち帰る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外した紙一枚だけ記録用に引き取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to keep just one for our records. I don't need to take them all home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect just one removed sheet for your records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一枚を窓口でお預かりします。あす以降にお受け取りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll keep one at the counter. You can collect it from tomorrow onward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、あす受け取りに来ます。次の交流会はまだ日が決まっていないので、今回は新しい案内は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 翌日の受取と次回案内未作成を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll come tomorrow. We haven't set a date for the next gathering yet, so we won't put up a new notice this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will collect it tomorrow and have not prepared a notice for the next gathering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、あすお待ちしております。交流会お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll see you tomorrow. Thank you for your work on the gathering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 面会にいらした方ですね。お荷物についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to visit someone, correct? Do you have a question about what you've brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母へ花を持ってきました。このまま病室へ運んでもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母への花束を病室へ運べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought flowers for my mother. May I take them straight to her room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take a bouquet for your mother to her hospital room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病棟へ確認します。お母様のお部屋を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the ward. Which room is your mother in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この面会の紙に書いてある部屋です。小さい花束ですが、花瓶は持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 面会紙で部屋を示し花瓶未持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The room written on this visitor slip. It's a small bouquet, but I haven't brought a vase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the room on the visitor slip and say you have not brought a vase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの病棟では、花は病室へ持ち込まず、ご自宅へお持ち帰りいただく案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this ward, we ask visitors to take flowers home rather than bring them into patients' rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。花は私が持ち帰ります。カードだけ母へ渡すことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持帰りに同意しカードだけ渡せるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll take the flowers home. May I give my mother just the card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to take the flowers home and ask whether you can give her just the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードはお持ちいただけます。花束から取り出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may take the card. Can you remove it from the bouquet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、外側のリボンに付いているので、すぐ外せます。母にはカードだけを渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花束外のカードを取り出して母へ渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it's attached to the ribbon outside, so I can remove it straight away. I'll give my mother just the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the card from the outside of the bouquet and give it to your mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お花をお持ちのまま面会するのが難しければ、一度お車へ戻られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it would be difficult to visit while holding the flowers, would you like to go back to your car first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。車へ花を置いて、カードを持って戻ります。母には、花は家で飾ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花を車へ置きカード持参で戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll do that. I'll leave the flowers in the car and come back with the card. I'll tell my mother we'll display the flowers at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the flowers in the car and return with the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、カードをお忘れなく。戻られましたらお声がけください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please remember your card. Speak to us when you return. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど届けてくださった鍵の件ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the key you handed in earlier, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家へ帰りかけましたが、キーホルダーの裏に文字があったことを言い忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届けた鍵の裏文字を伝え忘れたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I was on my way home, but I forgot to mention the lettering on the back of the key ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you forgot to mention the lettering on the back of the key ring you handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届いた鍵をこちらで確認します。どのような文字でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the key we received. What letters were there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表は星の絵で、裏には「Ｋ」とありました。届ける時には、星だけ説明しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表の星と裏のＫの文字を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a star picture on the front and a “K” on the back. When I handed it in, I only mentioned the star.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the star on the front and the letter K on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 裏にＫの文字がありますね。ほかに気づいた特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, there is a K on the back. Did you notice any other features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒いひもが付いています。鍵は一つでしたが、ひもの輪も特徴になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒いひもと鍵一本の特徴を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a black cord. There was one key, but I thought the loop of cord could also help identify it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add that there is a black cord and just one key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鍵が一つ、黒いひも、星の表とＫの裏ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: One key, a black cord, a star on the front, and K on the back, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、その説明で合っています。拾った場所と時刻は、最初に話したままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 特徴を確認し拾得場所時刻は変更なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, that description is right. The place and time I found it are the same as I first told you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the features and say the place and time it was found have not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴を記録に追加します。ご連絡先にも変更はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll add those features to the record. Have your contact details changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変わりません。書いた携帯番号で連絡できます。文字を付け足せたので、今日はこれで帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既記入の携帯連絡先が変わらないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. You can reach me on the mobile number I wrote down. I've added the letter now, so I'll head home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the mobile contact number you already wrote down has not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 追加のお知らせありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for the additional information. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの絵はがきをお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send this picture postcard?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。表は絵だけなので、住所も文章も裏に書くようですね。どこに住所を書くか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 絵はがきの宛先を書く位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The front has only a picture, so it looks as though both the address and message go on the back. Please show me where to write the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to write the recipient's address on a picture postcard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この縦の線から右側が、宛先を書く部分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The area to the right of this vertical line is for the recipient's address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。左側は友達への文章にします。相手の住所が長いので、右側を少し広く使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左側に本文を書き長い宛先用の余白を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll write my message to my friend on the left. Their address is long, so I'd like to use a little more space on the right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will write the message on the left and want room for the long recipient address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所とお名前が読みやすいようにお書きください。郵便番号はこちらの欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write the address and name clearly. The postal code goes in this box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号から書きます。建物の名前は住所の次の行にしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵便番号記入と建物名の改行を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll start with the code. May I put the building name on the line after the address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm writing the postal code and putting the building name on a new line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行を分けて構いません。部屋番号も忘れずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may use separate lines. Please remember the room number too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所を二行にして、最後に部屋番号を入れました。友達の名前はその下に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二行住所と部屋番号と友人名を記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've written the address on two lines and added the room number at the end. I'll write my friend's name underneath.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are entering a two-line address, the room number, and your friend's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人の住所とお名前も、左側に分かるようにお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also clearly write the sender's address and name on the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。文章を少し短くして、自分の住所と名前も書きます。全部書いてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本文を短くし自分の住所氏名も書いてから出すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll shorten the message a little and write my own address and name too. I'll bring it over when I've finished writing everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will shorten the message and add your address and name before handing it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備できましたらお出しください。お便りが届くのを楽しみにされるでしょうね。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand it in when you're ready. I'm sure they'll look forward to receiving it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳のどの部分についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of your bankbook would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この口座の情報を家族に送るつもりでしたが、家賃の振込先とは違うと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の通帳情報と家賃振込先を混同したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to send my family this account information, but I realized it isn't the account for paying the rent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused your own bankbook information with the rent payment account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに印字されているのは、お客様ご自身の口座の情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The information printed here is for your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の名前があるのでそうですね。大家さんへ払う口座を知らせたいのに、自分の口座を写真に撮っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己名義の写真を家賃支払先として撮ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it has my name. I wanted to tell them the account for paying the landlord, but I photographed my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you photographed your own account as though it were the rent payment account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家賃の振込先を確認できる案内は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have anything showing the rent payment account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今はありません。大家さんからもらった紙が家にあるので、それを見て家族へ送り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の大家の案内を見て家族へ送り直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not with me. The paper the landlord gave me is at home, so I'll check it and send my family the correct information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the landlord's paper at home and resend the information to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送り先の名前と口座情報も、その案内でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the recipient's name and account information on that notice too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族には、さっき送った写真は私の口座で、家賃の支払先ではないと先に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送信済写真は自己口座と家族へ訂正連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. First I'll tell my family the photo I sent earlier shows my own account and is not the rent payment account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will correct your earlier message to your family, explaining the photo shows your own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日、振込みのお手続きもされる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Were you also planning to make a transfer today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はしません。案内を家で確かめます。振込みが必要になったら、正しい支払先の紙を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日振込なしで必要時に正しい支払先紙を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not today. I'll check the notice at home. If I need to make a transfer, I'll bring the paper with the correct payment account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not make a transfer today and will bring the correct payment-account paper when needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、通帳をお返しします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is your bankbook back. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 米袋から何か落ちていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something falling out of the rice bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、かごへ入れたら米が少し落ちました。袋の下に小さい穴があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 米袋下部の穴と粒の落下を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, some rice fell out when I put it in the basket. There's a small hole at the bottom of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a hole in the bottom of the rice bag and falling grains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋はそのままにしてください。落ちた所を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave the bag as it is. Could you show me where the rice fell?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 棚のすぐ前です。かごはまだそこに置いてあります。レジへ歩く前に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 棚前の床と置いたままのかごを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right in front of the shelf. The basket is still there. I noticed before walking to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the floor in front of the shelf and the basket left there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで袋とかごを引き取ります。床の米も片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll take the bag and basket. We'll clean up the rice on the floor too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。別の袋を買いたいです。隣の袋も見てから選んでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別袋を選ぶため隣の商品を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'd like to buy a different bag. May I look at the bag next to it before choosing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to inspect the neighboring product to choose another bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。外から見て気になる所があれば、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If you notice anything concerning when looking at the outside, please tell us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは穴が見えません。同じ二キロ入りなので、この一袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ二キロの穴が見えない米袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can't see any holes in this one. It's also a two-kilogram bag, so I'll take this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose another two-kilogram rice bag with no visible holes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋を入れ替えました。ほかの商品もかごへ戻してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've replaced the bag. Your other items are back in the basket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。米の下にパンがあったので、パンを上へ置き直します。このかごで会計へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入替後品を確認しパンを米上へ移して会計に向かうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked. The bread was under the rice, so I'll move it on top. I'll take this basket to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have checked the replaced items, will move the bread above the rice, and will go to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。それでは、お買い物をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Please continue your shopping.
